cases.description: Holds of 40000 then 20000 in July accumulate in the manual hold.
Holding the whole July To Budget leaves nothing to budget.
A hold larger than July To Budget is clamped to To Budget.
A second hold in July is clamped to the To Budget left after the first.
Resetting the manual hold returns the held amount to July To Budget.
A direct reset-hold with no stored hold row writes a zero manual hold. The menu offers reset only when a manual hold is set.
After a release, a new hold starts from a zero manual hold.
Money held in July returns as August from-last-month and To Budget.
A December hold returns through the 2026-12 to 2027-01 sheet link.
With no July To Budget, a direct hold call returns false and writes no hold cells. The menu hides Hold when To Budget is not positive.
With negative July To Budget, a direct hold call returns false and writes no hold cells. The menu hides Hold when To Budget is not positive.
Releasing a manual hold reveals the income-carryover hold, which the next reset clears.
Calling the hold handler without the menu reset replaces an active automatic hold with the manual amount.
Tracking budgets have no Hold menu item. The handler result is recorded as the direct-call outcome.
A hold in January 2027 with no stored month row creates the row.
Actualist-shaped CRDT cells for a manual hold and income carryover reset apply to Actual core.
